observations.title: Underground Cabin exploration
observations.player_action: Explore underground; discover an Underground Cabin. Look for its Spelunkery Table and loot container.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Найди подземную хижину и изучи стол спелеолога.

observations.title: Find Cave Tablets
observations.player_action: Loot a Cave Tablet from a suitable structure, especially an Underground Cabin.
observations.outcome: Untranslated tablet for one rare cave biome.
observations.review_note: Tablet variants and NBT must be checked in the installed JAR before an exact-ID FTB task.

observations.title: Translate a Cave Tablet
observations.player_action: Use a Spelunkery Table with a Cave Tablet and paper; complete its three-stage symbol-guessing minigame.
observations.outcome: Produces a cave codex identifying a cave biome.

observations.title: Build or find a Cave Compendium
observations.player_action: Find the guide in an Underground Cabin or craft it using a Cave Tablet, a book and a gold nugget.

observations.title: Locate a rare cave biome
observations.player_action: Turn a researched Cave Codex into a cave biome map and follow the map toward its cave type.
observations.outcome: Guided travel to a rare cave biome.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Создай карту пещерного биома и найди его.

observations.title: Learn a cave biome
observations.player_action: Use Cave Codices to reveal General, Resources, Inhabitants and Utilities entries in the Cave Compendium.
observations.outcome: Unlock knowledge progressively instead of giving spoiler-heavy descriptions.
observations.review_note: Specific chapter count may vary by version and biome; treat as guide inspiration until exact JAR verified.
